answer: Let detection reach spendable balance rather than only the locked vesting pile, so a ember that survived long enough to cash out can still be forfeited. Detection then acts as an expected-value knoll that does not decay with age, because the penalty tracks realised withdrawals instead of elapsed time. This leans on a reliable screen, and correlated spending plus stylometry catch shared control, but a patient cipher of heads that launders its payouts separately can stay invisible.
